generationInputs.prompt: A vintage-style poster, inspired by 1950s beauty ads, printed in a limited red-toned palette on a cream background, showcases a luminous pink donut, an eggplant with a syringe, and glistening white viscous liquid amidst a foggy, dark background with sparkling diamonds. The poster features a large, bold headline at the top that reads "GOTTA HAVE MY FIX!" arching across in all caps, with mid-century sparkle icons scattered around. Below, a tagline states "SWEET OBSESSION." The central stylized, engraved illustration depicts a luminous pink donut with holographic shimmering pink icing and tiny, brightly colored, translucent sprinkles, its base a soft golden hue, appearing almost weightless. Beside it, an eggplant holds a syringe, and glistening white viscous liquid floats around. The background features a cream-toned dark fog with red-toned, sparkling diamonds on the floor. A funny footer line at the bottom states "STILL CRAVING." All fonts are stylized mid-century serif.
